processes.label: STLC Workflow
processes.title: Software Testing Life Cycle
processes.summary: End-to-end software testing flow from requirement intake to sign-off.
processes.def:
flowchart LR
  Start_1([Requirement Received]) --> Task_RA[Requirement Analysis]
  Task_RA --> Task_TP[Test Planning]
  Task_TP --> Task_TC[Test Case Design]
  Task_TC --> Task_ENV[Environment Setup]
  Task_ENV --> Task_EXE[Test Execution]
  Task_EXE --> Task_CLO[Test Closure]
  Task_CLO --> End_1([Sign-off])

Start_1.title: Requirement Received
Start_1.desc: A new feature or change request enters the testing pipeline.

Task_RA.title: Requirement Analysis
Task_RA.desc: Analyse testability of requirements and identify what can be automated.
activities: Log testability matrix in the test management tool

Task_TP.title: Test Planning
Task_TP.desc: Define scope, strategy, effort estimate, and resourcing.

Task_TC.title: Test Case Design
Task_TC.desc: Author test cases and scripts, prepare test data.
activities: Map cases to requirements for traceability

Task_ENV.title: Environment Setup
Task_ENV.desc: Provision and validate the test environment — often manual coordination.

Task_EXE.title: Test Execution
Task_EXE.desc: Run test cases, log defects, retest fixes.
activities: Retest and run regression on fixes

Task_CLO.title: Test Closure
Task_CLO.desc: Summarise results and capture lessons learned.

End_1.title: Sign-off
End_1.desc: Business and QA sign off; release proceeds.

processes.label: Loan Onboarding
processes.title: Loan Application Onboarding
processes.summary: From application intake through verification, credit decision, and disbursal.
processes.def:
flowchart LR
  Start_1([Application Submitted]) --> Task_KYC[KYC & Document Capture]
  Task_KYC --> Task_VER[Physical Verification]
  Task_VER --> Task_CR[Credit Assessment]
  Task_CR --> GW_1{Approved?}
  GW_1 -->|Yes| Task_SAN[Sanction & Documentation]
  GW_1 -->|No| Task_REJ[Rejection & Notify]
  Task_SAN --> Task_DIS[Disbursement]
  Task_DIS --> End_OK([Onboarded])
  Task_REJ --> End_NO([Closed - Declined])

Start_1.title: Application Submitted
Start_1.desc: A prospective borrower submits a loan application through a channel.

Task_KYC.title: KYC & Document Capture
Task_KYC.desc: Verify identity and collect mandatory documents.

Task_VER.title: Physical Verification
Task_VER.desc: Field verification of address / collateral, performed outside the system.

Task_CR.title: Credit Assessment
Task_CR.desc: Pull bureau data and score the applicant against policy.

GW_1.title: Approval Decision
GW_1.desc: Decision gateway — approve, reject, or refer for manual review.
activities: Route high-value cases for committee review

Task_SAN.title: Sanction & Documentation
Task_SAN.desc: Generate the sanction letter and loan agreement.

Task_DIS.title: Disbursement
Task_DIS.desc: Create the loan account and disburse funds.

Task_REJ.title: Rejection & Notify
Task_REJ.desc: Communicate decline and reason to the applicant.

End_OK.title: Onboarded
End_OK.desc: Loan is live and the customer is onboarded.
